description_en: Queries the detailed configurations of domain names that have been added to WAF for protection
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainAdvanceConfigs查询已添加到WAF防护的域名的详细配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain-advance-configs --instance-id waf-cn-2r427ng0000 --domain-list www.aliyundoc.com --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtop0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainAdvanceConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain names whose configurations you want to query. You can specify multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html to query all domain names that have been added to WAF for protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询配置详情的域名。支持同时设置多个域名，多个域名间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已接入WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the domain name belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
网站域名在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
